callbackProcs.Name: runsql
callbackProcs.Body:
db eval {CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t4(q)}
  sqlite3_step $::STMT
  set rc [sqlite3_column_int $::STMT 0]
  sqlite3_reset $::STMT
  return $rc
